name: Fleet: 400 gRPC services (Prometheus)
description: The stress model: in-flight requests for every gRPC service and lag for every consumer group, read from Prometheus with PromQL. Only the stocks are given: no flows, not even the calls coming in or the handled requests going out. Import history (7 days) or Start, then Discover flows and see what the levels alone reveal. Each replica change starts an era. With this many stocks, select a team's services (search the namespace) before charting.
